profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-based public company, traded as HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions. According to its website, it makes lidar sensors for ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications, and says it delivers mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries. It describes its sensors as providing high-resolution 3D perception that enables features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot), and says its sensors meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving used by robotaxis and robobuses.

The company says it partners with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide. Its stated focus spans ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, which it frames as enabling physical AI.

The record held on the company lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Corporate registry information gives its CIK as 0001861737 and its headquarters as Shanghai.
